summary: Frontend-only test of calendar/date localisation (partner + customer), admin Hindi mode, and the wallet reset. Everything requested works: partner calendar month title in Hindi ('अक्टूबर 2026', prev/next gives 'सितंबर'/'नवंबर 2026'), weekday headers सो मं बु गु शु श र, off-day chips सोम…रवि with 'रवि · छुट्टी', job list dates '18 अक्टू॰ 2026', calendar day details in Hindi. English mode shows 'October 2026' and M T W T F S S. Earnings chart: daily सोम…रवि, weekly '05 अक्तू॰'. Customer in Hindi: checkout chips रवि/सोम/मंगल/बुध/गुरु, bookings 'बुक किया 18 अक्टू॰, 12:54 pm', wallet transaction time in Hindi. Admin toggle switches the whole panel to Hindi and back with no reload (no frame navigation): sidebar, title, KPIs, chart legend and axis labels, alerts, tabs and table headers, reassign dialog, cities, pricing, KYC, partners, finance. The setting survives reload and a fresh login. Hindi-mode actions work: reassign dialog opens with translated candidates, coupon created (toast 'कूपन TESTHI10 बना'), settlement generated ('1 सेटलमेंट बने'), commission invoice dialog opens. Wallet reset confirmed: GET /api/customer/wallet returned {balance:250, transactions:[]}. No page errors or console errors in any app. Found 1 medium issue (logo text gets translated) and a few low ones (gaps and inconsistencies).

ui_bugs.component: Admin sidebar brand logo (AdminApp.jsx line 126: HomeServe)
ui_bugs.issue: The 'Home' text node matches HI.Home, so the brand shows as 'होमServe' in Hindi mode. The same HomeServe pattern in the customer/partner apps is probably affected too.

issues: Month abbreviations differ on the same screen. The i18n_admin MONTHS map gives 'अक्तू॰' (chart axis) but Intl hi-IN fmtDT gives 'अक्टू॰' (alert timestamps). Use one spelling, e.g. build the MONTHS map from Intl hi-IN { month: 'short' }.
Finance settlement period '2026-10-18→2026-10-18' and the commission invoice 'Billed to … 2026-10-18 → 2026-10-18'
Admin alert details keep English service names ('पार्टनर Ramesh Kumar · Refrigerator Repair'). The Partner pattern does not run HI lookups on the inner parts.
Surge rule card 'Lucknow · Rain' and 'सभी शहर · 18:00–21:00 IST'
Checkout time slots '09:00 AM' and fmtDT 'am/pm' stay in Latin script (Chrome hi-IN output; acceptable but could use पूर्वाह्न/अपराह्न)

action_items: Stop the brand 'HomeServe' from being translated. Render it as one text node or make walk() skip elements marked translate='no' or data-no-i18n.
Use one Hindi month abbreviation everywhere: the ADMIN_PATTERNS MONTHS map vs Intl hi-IN ('अक्तू॰' vs 'अक्टू॰').
Format the remaining raw ISO dates with fmtDate: coupon valid_till, settlement period_start/period_end, KYC expiry_date, partner DL expiry banner.
Optional: translate service names inside admin alert details, the weather name in surge rules, and 'Billed to' on the commission invoice.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n.js useHindi sets the module-level `current` locale during render. It works here because AdminApp, CustomerApp and PartnerApp are the root render for each route. It would break if two apps ever rendered together, or if a memoised child formatted dates before the parent re-rendered.

The translation walker matches text nodes exactly against a global dictionary, so any short English word that happens to be in HI (Home, Add, Code, Value…) gets translated even when it is part of a brand or proper noun. Add an opt-out attribute.
The `done` Map only prunes disconnected nodes after it passes 3000 entries, and `ph` is never pruned while Hindi mode is on. This could leak memory on long admin sessions with polling tables.
